description: Brings a multi-service project from a code repository online as one app, reachable at a single public web address.
author: jengakit

ui.description: Brings a multi-service project online from its code repository: the web app gets one public address and its supporting services stay private to the project.

sample_prompts: Import a multi-service compose repo into jengaKIT
Run a docker-compose stack from a git repository
